client_launch.description: Configuration for the client-launch module, which controls how Xymon (Hobbit) dynamically launches client-side tests.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the client-launch module.

client_hosts.description: List of hostname glob patterns to limit which clients get auto-launched. Empty list means all clients are launched.

items.description: A glob pattern (e.g., 'web*' or 'db[0-9]*') matching allowed client hostnames.

client_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between checks that client tests should be launched.

max_concurrent.description: Maximum number of client tests that may be launched concurrently.

cmd_prefix.description: Command prefix (e.g., 'sudo -u hobbit') to wrap test commands. Leave empty to use default.

base_dir.description: Base directory where client test scripts are stored and executed from.

tests.description: List of custom client tests to be launched on matched clients.

items.description: A named test with its command and options.

name.description: Unique name of the test (alphanumeric + hyphens/underscores recommended).

cmd.description: Command to run for this test (relative to base_dir or absolute path).

timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) before the test is considered failed due to timeout.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this specific test.
